simple.meaning: to pull down or in pieces, break , destroy
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הָרַס (H2040) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 43 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.

definitions.short: to pull down or in pieces, break , destroy
definitions.usage: beat down, break (down, through), destroy, overthrow, pluck down, pull down, ruin, throw down, × utterly.
definitions.full: H2040. haras הָרַס verb throw down, break or tear down (MI הרם ; ? Arabic , bruise, bray, pound, crush (grain)) — Qal Perfect ׳הָ Lam 2:2 , 17 ; הָרָ֑ס Isa 14:17 ; וְהָרַסְתָּ֫ Judg 6:25 וְהָרַסְתִּ֫י Ezek 13:14 ; Micah 5:10 ; וְהָֽרְסוּ Ezek 16:39 ; 26:4 , 12 הָרָ֑סוּ 1Kin 19:10 , 14 ; Imperfect יַהֲרוֺס Job 12:14 ; suffix יֶהֶרְסֶ֑ךָ Isa 22:19 ; וַיֶּהֶרְסֶ֑הָ 1Chr 20:1 ; יֶהֶרְסֶנָּה Prov 29:4 יֶהֶרְסֵם Psa 28:5 ; 3 feminine singular suffix 3 masculine singular תֶּהֶרְסֶנּוּ Prov 14:1-2 ;masculine singular תַּהֲרֹס Exod 15:7 ; אֶהֱרֹס Jer 24:6 ; 42:10 אֶהֱרוֺס Mal 1:4 ; 3 masculine plural יֶהֶרְסוּ Exod 19:21 , 24 ; יַהֲרֹ֑סוּ 2Kin 3:25 ; Imperative הֲרָסֿ Psa 58:7 ; suffix הָרְסָהּ 2Sam 11:25 ; Infinitive הֲרֹס Jer 31:28 הֲרוֺס 1:10 ; Participle active הֹרֵס 45:4 ; passive הָרוּס 1Kin 18:30 ; — 1 throw down, tear down , with accusative: altar(s) Judg 6:25 ; 1Kin 18:30 ; 19:10 , 14 ; height ( גַּב , where idol-altar stood ? compare גֶּב below גבב ) Ezek 16:39 ; city (cities) Isa 14:17 ; 2Sam 11:25 ; 2Kin 3:25 ; 1Chr 20:1 (compare MI 27 ) Mal 1:4 (object not expressed); wall(s) Ezek 13:14 ; 26:12 ; house Prov 14:1 (figurative of foolish woman's action); strongholds ( מִבְצָרִים ) Lam 2:2 ; Micah 5:10 ; tower(s) Ezek 26:4 ; figurative overthrow (i.e. ruin ) land Prov 29:4 (opposed to יַעֲמִיד ); object men Exod 15:7 (poem in E) Isa 22:19 ( cast down Shebna from office); figurative, opposed to building up, of Yahweh's dealings with men Psa 28:5 , compare (without object) Jer 24:6 ; 42:10 ; object indefinite הֹרֵס אֲנִי בָּנִיתִי אשׁר 45:4 ; absolute 1:10 ; 31:28 ; Lam 2:17 ; Job 12:14 . 2 break down, break away ׳ה בְּפִימוֺ שִׁנֵּימוֺ Psa 58:7 break away their teeth in their mouth! figurative, addressed to God. 3 break through , intransitive, followed by ׳אֶליֿ Exod 19:21 ; followed by אֶליֿ ׳לַעֲלֹת , 19:24 (both J). Niph`al Perfect 3feminine singular נֶהֱרָ֑סָה Prov 24:31 ; 3 plural נֶהֶרְסוּ Jer 50:15 ; Joel 1:17 ; וְנֶהֶרְסוּ consecutive Ezek 30:4 ; 38:20 ; Imperfect יֵהָרֵס Jer 31:40 ; 3 feminine singular תֵּהָרֵס Prov 11:11 ; יֵהָרֵס֑וּן Psa 11:3 ; Participle הַנֶּהֱרָסוֺת Ezek 36:35-36 , — be thrown or torn down ; wall(s) of vineyard Prov 24:31 , of city Jer 50:15 ; cities Ezek 36:35 compare 36:36 ; figurative ruined Prov 11:11 (opposed to תָּרוּם ); foundations, יְסוֺדֹת Ezek 30:4 ; שָׁתוֺת Psa 11:3 ; mountains Ezek 38:20 ; storehouses מַמְּגֻרוֺת Joel 1:17 [see ׳מ ]; valley east of Jerusalem וְלֹאיֵֿהָרֵס לֹאיִֿנָּתֵשׁ Jer 31:40 it shall not be plucked up nor thrown down , apparently proverb. expression, implying destruction, removal. Pi`el Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix תְּהָֽרְסֵם Exod 23:24 ; Infinitive absolute הָרֵס 23:24 ; Participle plural suffix מְהָֽרְסַיִךְ Isa 49:17 ; — overthrow, tear down תְּהָֽרְסֵם הָרֵס Exod 23:24 thou shalt utterly tear them down (J E; object = idols compare Di); participle destroyers , of Zion Isa 49:17 (|| מַחֲרִיבַיִךְ ).
